import subprocess, sys, json, time, random
rng = random.Random(5)
svc = ['t%d'%i for i in range(24)]
lines = []
for i in range(8):
    specs = [tuple(rng.choice(svc) for _ in range(4)) for _ in range(10)]
    when = {'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for p in specs]}
    lines.append(json.dumps({'services':svc,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':when}],'queries':[[svc[0],svc[1]]]}))
payload = ('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode()
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=payload, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print('8 heavy lines: %.2fs, %.1f MB out' % (time.time()-t0, len(p.stdout)/1e6))
EOF
